title: Credit Store is live, Donator Pins now claim properly, and we're on Discord
body: The in-game Credit Store is fully stocked - every category (Weapons, Armory, Boosts, Pets, Cosmetic, Supplies & Misc) has real items with real prices, and checkout works. Donator Pins now correctly grant Credits when claimed, and a Sanguine Torva equip bug (helm/body/legs couldn't be worn) is fixed. Also: Morphscape now has an official Discord at discord.gg/morphscape - come say hi.

title: Morphscape has moved to a new server build
body: Morphscape is now running on a new server build with its own content, bosses, and systems. The site has been updated to match - old patch notes describing the previous build have been retired since they no longer reflect what's actually in the game. More updates coming as new content ships.
